### SEO and GEO services in Switzerland.

Source: https://fawazbhseo.in/seo-services-switzerland

The Switzerland page, /seo-services-switzerland, explains remote SEO and GEO consulting rather than a Swiss office. It discusses multilingual market differences, technical structure, entity clarity, AI answers and native-language final copy. Strategy, structure, briefs and structured data are separated from the native speaker's responsibility for final wording.

Named local coverage: Zurich, Geneva, Basel, Bern, Lausanne, Zug, Lucerne.

Sectors described: B2B and industrial exporters, Professional and financial services, SaaS and technology companies, Hospitality and destination businesses, Healthcare and specialist clinics, Companies with weak AI answer visibility.

Delivery: I am based in Kushal Nagar, Kodagu, India, so a Swiss engagement is entirely remote. Calls are scheduled rather than on demand: India Standard Time is three and a half to four and a half hours ahead of Switzerland depending on daylight saving, which means a Swiss morning slot works comfortably for both of us. I would rather agree a predictable weekly window than promise availability across your whole working day and fail to keep it. On language, the working language is English. Where native German, French or Italian copy is needed, I build the strategy, structure, briefs and structured data, and a native speaker on your side or a local writer produces the final wording. That is the honest division of labour and it produces better copy than any translation workflow I could run.

## Guides and remaining page purposes

The homepage, /, introduces Fawaz's independent practice, the connected SEO/AEO/GEO approach, the six search disciplines, the audit-to-reporting process, credentials and routes to contact or further detail.

The services page, /seo-services, is the main service catalogue and published rate card. It explains technical SEO, local SEO, AEO, GEO, SEO content strategy and LinkedIn/personal-brand SEO, and publishes the SEO, social media, performance-marketing and website-design packages described above.

The AEO page, /aeo-consultant, explains answer extraction, the search and answer surfaces involved, AEO workstreams, cited research, how visibility is measured, qualifications, scope/pricing guidance, limitations and answers to prospective-client questions.

The GEO page, /geo-consultant, explains visibility inside synthesised AI answers. It covers engine differences, GEO workstreams, research and sources, measurement, buying criteria, qualifications, scope/pricing guidance, limitations and prospective-client questions.

The AI SEO page, /ai-seo-expert-india, explains what AI SEO means and separates SEO, AEO and GEO. It discusses changes in search, the distinction between using AI tools and being visible in AI answers, content preparation and questions to ask a potential provider.

The case-studies page, /case-studies, describes the Green Coorg Spices website build, its historical first-page Google rankings and the current expired-hosting/offline status while a rebuilt version is in progress. It also lists current work for neelachandra.com and neelachandrainteriors.com, and ILMERA as the co-founder’s own venture rather than an arm’s-length client. These examples do not promise the same outcome for another business.

The geographic overview, /cities-we-serve, explains local versus remote delivery and groups coverage from Kodagu through Karnataka, South India, India and selected international enquiry markets. It explains meetings, time-zone arrangements and how an unlisted city can be discussed.

The about page, /about, gives Fawaz's background, early-2025 start in SEO, move into AEO/GEO, named qualifications, direct working model, process, principles and reasons for being based in Kodagu.

The contact page, /contact, provides phone, WhatsApp, both email addresses, LinkedIn, the business base, working days and the enquiry process. It explains the free written audit, agreement before paid work, usual response time, and that the form opens a WhatsApp draft rather than submitting a message to the site.

The blog archive, /blog, introduces the site's practical search guides and points readers to the three educational articles. It is an editorial archive, not a separate service or a measured-results page.

The guide at /blogs/seo-aeo-geo-differences compares SEO, AEO and GEO, explains their overlap and uses an explicitly illustrative business example. It is educational, not evidence of a client engagement.

Read the full guide: https://fawazbhseo.in/blogs/seo-aeo-geo-differences compares SEO

The guide at /blogs/measure-ai-search-visibility explains a manual way to distinguish mentions, direct-site citations, third-party citations, recommendations and enquiries. It links to a blank CSV worksheet and explains sample limitations; the worksheet is not a collection of actual results.

Read the full guide: https://fawazbhseo.in/blogs/measure-ai-search-visibility explains a manual way to distinguish mentions

The guide at /blogs/local-seo-checklist-karnataka covers business-profile accuracy, genuine service areas, useful local pages, language research, genuine reviews and enquiry measurement. It is a practical checklist rather than a results claim. Long-form article text is not reproduced in this grounding file.

Read the full guide: https://fawazbhseo.in/blogs/local-seo-checklist-karnataka covers business-profile accuracy

## Maintenance and limits

The original PHP pages remain the complete source. This file intentionally condenses the 19 geographic pages and links to the three guides instead of reproducing them. Research source names, dates, samples and caveats above are those currently stated on the source pages. The shared source register adds checked original-publisher links and bibliographic metadata, not approval of every retained claim. Repeated mechanism/comparison/choosing-provider material is condensed through the page-purpose notes and source links, while all AEO/GEO workstreams, research blocks and FAQs remain. Repeated contact/credential furniture is centralised.

The testing date in these generated snapshots comes from index.php's $ai_testing_as_of variable. Edit that one source value after a real re-test, then regenerate and upload the static summaries. These snapshots do not update automatically when PHP changes. This testing date is not a reviewed_on value or sitemap lastmod. The separately managed chat backend must be configured by its owner; this maintenance pass does not read or modify it.
